summary: While working in the roamer room, Bob covertly listens to Dr. Landers's confrontation with Minister Jacoby. Jacoby condemns the replicant enterprise as spiritually dangerous and threatens Landers, while Landers answers that the Ministry of Truth officially supports and funds the work. Bob's ROAMer can pick up the conversation through vibrations in the wall despite Landers disabling the intercom; after Jacoby leaves, Landers sends Bob back to his exercise.

introducing.name: Minister Jacoby
introducing.current_state: Threatening Dr. Landers over his participation in the replicant enterprise.

updates.description: Remote observation and manipulation devices directed through GUPPI. They come in varied sizes, coordinate across scales and, once their tasks are defined, need little supervision. They can climb floors, walls and ceilings, carry video cameras and pick up vibrations through a wall.

A FAITH ministry that finances the replicant venture and has military, colonization, and diplomatic responsibilities. It officially supports and actively funds the replicant enterprise, and holds that the enterprise's machine minds are without souls but are based on God's creation rather than attempts to usurp divine authority.
